scope: Additive Earthquake Boots L1-18 target and geometry audit across the 2025 building nerf and 2026 ground-troop change; preserve level fields without guessing current area damage.
game_version: Official 2023-12-12 Equipment release, 2025-02 balance change and 2026-02-23 ground-troop update; game-file table dated 2026-09-01 and claimed client build 18.600.3 on 2026-09-16; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Hero Equipment
facts: Earthquake Boots are Common active Barbarian King Equipment. Their activation damages Walls and Buildings, with a Hero damage and HP bonus; Blacksmith level 1 unlocks them.
sources.limitations: No radius, damage percentage, Wall destruction formula, target eligibility or activation tick order is supplied.

sources.title: Hero Equipment Balance Changes!
facts: Supercell announced lower building damage for Earthquake Boots and said the ability would no longer affect Skeleton Trap skeletons.
sources.limitations: The article does not give replacement percentages or explain whether the Skeleton Trap exception remains after the later 2026 ground-troop change.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
facts: The Earthquake Spell now damages ground troops in addition to Buildings and Walls, and the release notes explicitly say this affects Earthquake Boots as well.
sources.limitations: No per-level ground-troop damage, target exclusion list, radius, damage order or relation to the 2025 Skeleton Trap exclusion is given.

sources.title: Earthquake Boots: costs, times and levels — Clash of Clans
sources.version: Game-file data dated 2026-09-01, processed 2026-09-03; exact client build unpublished
facts: The TH18 maximum is L18. Per-level Hero HP, DPS, ore costs and Blacksmith requirements agree with the pinned payload.
sources.limitations: The table does not give activation radius or building, Wall or ground-troop damage percentages.

sources.title: Earthquake Boots — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The page states that activation destroys Walls and damages ground targets; L1-18 Hero HP increases run 209-2500 and DPS increases 13-102.
sources.limitations: The page omits per-level area damage and exact Wall formula or target exceptions.

sources.title: Pinned Earthquake Boots Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: The normalized source_fields preserve top-level abilityRadius 8 and targets Ground; per-level buildingDamagePercent, troopDamagePercent, DPS and Hero HP bonuses remain present.
sources.limitations: The radius unit and distance test are unstated. Dated public tables do not corroborate the area-damage percentages or prove whether they reflect the post-2025 and post-2026 rules.

derivations.result: Preserve pinned level and ability fields as data-only
derivations.method: SHA-check all frozen raw fields; cross-check dated Hero HP and DPS tables. Official notes establish ground-troop eligibility after 2026-02-23 without supplying complete area-damage calculations.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the pinned buildingDamagePercent and troopDamagePercent as current post-2026 damage
rejected_inferences.reason: Neither dated public table exposes those percentages and the 2025 building nerf plus 2026 troop change make historical continuity material.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat abilityRadius 8 as eight tile center-to-center distance
rejected_inferences.reason: The raw field does not specify units, footprint treatment, hitbox intersection or geometry rounding.

rejected_inferences.rule: Affect all ground troops including Skeleton Trap skeletons
rejected_inferences.reason: The 2026 general ground-troop wording does not explicitly revoke the 2025 Skeleton Trap exception.

rejected_inferences.rule: Destroy all Walls in range with a single activation
rejected_inferences.reason: The descriptions do not define Wall damage formula, level and HP dependence or whether activation can partially damage a Wall.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply area damage simultaneously with King attack
rejected_inferences.reason: Activation, target enumeration, death and other Equipment effects have no sourced tick order.

items: current-build per-level building, Wall and ground-troop damage
radius units, center, hitbox and edge inclusion
Skeleton Trap skeleton exception after the 2026 ground-troop update
Wall destruction formula and multi-Wall resolution
defending Hero and Pet ground-target eligibility
damage, death, trap and King attack tick order
Hero HP and DPS bonus timing with a second Equipment item
Viewer effect art, activation overlay, replay and RL command contract

conclusion: Earthquake Boots L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official sources confirm Wall and Building damage and the 2026 addition of ground-troop damage, while dated tables verify passive Hero stats. Current area percentages, geometry and target exceptions remain insufficient for a faithful Core implementation.
